title_original: Tracking AI adoption in North Korean threat actor tradecraft
description: As Microsoft Threat Intelligence continues to track how threat actors operationalize AI to increase the speed and efficiency of attacks, we’ve identified North Korean threat actors expanding their use of AI with varying levels of adoption.
